# Manajemen Grup

Semua fungsi grup butuh akses admin (kecuali disebut).

## Membuat Grup

```ts
const group = await sock.groupCreate('Nama Grup', [
  '6281234567890@s.whatsapp.net',
  '6289876543210@s.whatsapp.net'
])

console.log('ID Grup:', group.id)
```

## Mendapatkan Metadata Grup

```ts
const meta = await sock.groupMetadata('123456789-12345@g.us')
console.log('Nama:', meta.subject)
console.log('Deskripsi:', meta.desc)
console.log('Anggota:', meta.participants?.length)
console.log('Pembuat:', meta.owner)
```

## Tambah/Hapus Anggota

```ts
// Tambah
await sock.groupParticipantsUpdate(
  '123456789-12345@g.us',
  ['6281234567890@s.whatsapp.net'],
  'add'
)

// Hapus
await sock.groupParticipantsUpdate(
  '123456789-12345@g.us',
  ['6281234567890@s.whatsapp.net'],
  'remove'
)
```

## Promote/Demote Admin

```ts
// Promote ke admin
await sock.groupParticipantsUpdate(
  '123456789-12345@g.us',
  ['6281234567890@s.whatsapp.net'],
  'promote'
)

// Demote dari admin
await sock.groupParticipantsUpdate(
  '123456789-12345@g.us',
  ['6281234567890@s.whatsapp.net'],
  'demote'
)
```

## Ubah Nama Grup

```ts
await sock.groupUpdateSubject('123456789-12345@g.us', 'Nama Baru')
```

## Ubah Deskripsi

```ts
await sock.groupUpdateDescription('123456789-12345@g.us', 'Deskripsi baru grup ini')
```

## Ubah Foto Grup

```ts
await sock.updateProfilePicture('123456789-12345@g.us', { url: './foto-grup.jpg' })

// Hapus foto
await sock.removeProfilePicture('123456789-12345@g.us')
```

## Pengaturan Grup

```ts
// Hanya admin bisa kirim pesan
await sock.groupSettingUpdate('123456789-12345@g.us', 'announcement')

// Semua anggota bisa kirim pesan
await sock.groupSettingUpdate('123456789-12345@g.us', 'not_announcement')

// Semua anggota bisa ubah settings grup
await sock.groupSettingUpdate('123456789-12345@g.us', 'unlocked')

// Hanya admin bisa ubah settings
await sock.groupSettingUpdate('123456789-12345@g.us', 'locked')
```

## Keluar dari Grup

```ts
await sock.groupLeave('123456789-12345@g.us')
```

## Undang Anggota (Invite)

### Dapatkan kode undangan

```ts
const code = await sock.groupInviteCode('123456789-12345@g.us')
console.log('Link undangan:', 'https://chat.whatsapp.com/' + code)
```

### Reset kode undangan

```ts
const newCode = await sock.groupRevokeInvite('123456789-12345@g.us')
```

### Gabung via kode undangan

```ts
const result = await sock.groupAcceptInvite('ABC123xyz')
console.log('Joined group:', result)
```

### Gabung via GroupInviteMessage

```ts
await sock.groupAcceptInviteV4('123456789-12345@g.us', groupInviteMessage)
```

## Approval Join (Request Join)

### Daftar permintaan join

```ts
const requests = await sock.groupRequestParticipantsList('123456789-12345@g.us')
console.log('Pending requests:', requests.length)
```

### Approve/Tolak

```ts
// Approve
await sock.groupRequestParticipantsUpdate(
  '123456789-12345@g.us',
  ['6281234567890@s.whatsapp.net'],
  'approve'
)

// Tolak
await sock.groupRequestParticipantsUpdate(
  '123456789-12345@g.us',
  ['6281234567890@s.whatsapp.net'],
  'reject'
)
```

## Mendapatkan Semua Grup

```ts
const groups = await sock.groupFetchAllParticipating()
for (const [id, meta] of Object.entries(groups)) {
  console.log(`${meta.subject} (${id})`)
}
```

## Pesan Sementara (Ephemeral)

```ts
// Set pesan sementara 24 jam
await sock.groupToggleEphemeral('123456789-12345@g.us', 86400)

// Set 7 hari
await sock.groupToggleEphemeral('123456789-12345@g.us', 604800)

// Matikan
await sock.groupToggleEphemeral('123456789-12345@g.us', 0)
```

## Mode Tambah Anggota

```ts
// Semua anggota bisa tambah orang
await sock.groupMemberAddMode('123456789-12345@g.us', 'all_member_add')

// Hanya admin
await sock.groupMemberAddMode('123456789-12345@g.us', 'admin_add')
```

## Event Group

```ts
// Anggota berubah
sock.ev.on('group-participants.update', ({ id, participants, action }) => {
  console.log(`Grup ${id}: ${action}`, participants)
})

// Metadata grup berubah (nama, foto, dll)
sock.ev.on('groups.update', (updates) => {
  for (const update of updates) {
    if (update.subject) console.log(`Nama grup berubah: ${update.subject}`)
  }
})
```

## Caching Group Metadata

Recommended untuk performa:

```ts
import NodeCache from 'node-cache'
const cache = new NodeCache({ stdTTL: 300 })

const sock = makeWASocket({
  cachedGroupMetadata: async (jid) => cache.get(jid),
})

sock.ev.on('groups.update', async ([event]) => {
  cache.set(event.id, await sock.groupMetadata(event.id))
})

sock.ev.on('group-participants.update', async (event) => {
  cache.set(event.id, await sock.groupMetadata(event.id))
})
```
